reviews.title: SCAM WARNING – UNAUTHORIZED CHARGES
reviews.text:
I authorized only a $0.50 trial.
Within seconds, two separate $49.99 charges were taken without my consent.

This was not approved via Face ID or Apple subscription confirmation.
I have reported this issue to Apple and my bank.

After checking reviews, I found multiple users reporting the exact same charging pattern.

This raises serious concerns about misleading billing practices.
Avoid this app and check your bank statements carefully.
reviews.reply: Hi there! Thank you for sharing your feedback. We’re sorry to hear about your experience and understand how concerning this situation must feel. Your report about unexpected charges and difficulties with subscription confirmation is very important, and we want to make sure it’s properly reviewed. Please reach out to us at support-appstore@asknebula.com with your transaction details. Our team will carefully check the information, verify the status of your account, and assist you further to resolve this issue. Best regards, Nebula Team🔮
